verdict.rationale: Datadog documents Bits AI (its AI investigation assistant) and Watchdog (automated anomaly/root-cause detection), both of which are designed to analyze alerts/errors and surface probable causes. However, the evidence pack only lists doc titles with no detail on investigation workflow, accuracy, or independent/hands-on validation of root-cause proposals. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of the investigation workflow, concrete examples of root-cause output, and independent/community corroboration of effectiveness.
